title: FOMC keeps moving long after the statement drops

hero.caption: That's the average NQ range **one hour** after the 14:00 release. CPI and NFP spike then die in the first 5 minutes — FOMC just keeps bleeding for the whole hour.

chart.label: How far NQ travels after the 14:00 release
chart.sub: Average high-to-low range, by window length
chart.note: The move doesn't fade after the statement bar. It expands the longer you hold.

useIt: I check this before every FOMC so I'm not surprised by the size. Expect ~70 pts in the first 5 minutes and a move that keeps running toward ~140 pts over the hour. Don't bet on a direction — across 10 years there's no up or down edge, FOMC runs both ways.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested on 10y NQ · check it yourself
